Elena (CS): @Priya quick sync - ZenVox needs a 5-day APAC pilot. Requests: add two CIDRs to allowlist for peering, pin to ap-northeast-1 edge, and a soft QPS bump to 500 for duration. Can infra & network confirm?
Priya (ZenVox): Pilot window 2026-06-10 -> 2026-06-14. CIDRs: 203.0.113.224/28 and 198.51.100.0/26. Steady 300 qps, bursts to ~480. Need read-only dashboard access for ops@zenvox.ai. Renewal touchpoint in 2 weeks, want smooth pilot.
Noah (Eng-Infra): Feasible. We'll use account-scoped ACL + TTL tag and soft quota alerting. Do you want auto-revoke? Also I'll add a capacity-based fallback policy.
Sana (Network): Auto-revoke=5 days OK. Recommend fallback to apac-2 if ap-northeast-1 utilization >70%. We'll add BGP community markers and path-flap monitoring.
Elena (CS): Auto-revoke=yes. Please tag logs with "zenvox-pilot-0610" and add dashboard invite. I'll open ticket CS-9999 to track enablement, renewal risk, and feedback capture.
Noah (Eng-Infra): Draft ops config (account-scoped): allowlist [203.0.113.224/28, 198.51.100.0/26], edge_pool=ap-northeast-1, qps=500 soft, auto_revoke_days=5, tag=zenvox-pilot-0610. Planned apply 2026-06-09T22:00Z.
Noah (Eng-Infra): Ops CLI (ops-only): `redwood infra acl add --account zenvox --cidr 203.0.113.224/28 --tag zenvox-pilot-0610 --ttl 5d` `redwood infra acl add --account zenvox --cidr 198.51.100.0/26 --tag zenvox-pilot-0610 --ttl 5d` `redwood infra routing set --account zenvox --edge-pool ap-northeast-1 --policy prefer` `redwood infra rate update --account zenvox --qps 500 --type soft`
ops-bot: queued change job job-131415 by Noah; expected apply 2026-06-09T22:00:00Z.
Sana (Network): Confirmed peering and route filters. I'll add monitoring for BGP and reroute flaps.
Noah (Eng-Infra): Adding fallback: prefer ap-northeast-1, fallback to apac-2 when util>70%, KV warmup 12s on reroute. Rollback rules: revert within 15m if error rate >1% or latency >250ms for 5m. I'll post telemetry 24h after start and a short summary at pilot end.
Priya (ZenVox): Thanks all — please grant ops@zenvox.ai read-only access and share sample eval prompts. We'll run a spike test on day 1.
Elena (CS): Following up: enablement call 2026-06-09 15:00 PT, CS-9999 tracks dashboard, renewal note, and NPS follow-up. Tag #eng-oncall if anything spikes.
Noah (Eng-Infra): Will post rollout + rollback summary in this thread when job starts.
Priya (ZenVox): :thumbsup:
Elena (CS): Closing loop for now.
